title: Application of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Company (1) under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G and amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 199, for approval by the quarterly fuel charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the biling months of February, March and April, 1988. The fuel charge reflects changes in prudentlly incurred, reasonable costs of fuel and power purchased by the Company's and (2) for approval by the Department of rates to be paid pursuant to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the fillings to be made by utilities with the Department, and implement the intent of sec. 201 and 210 of the Utilities Regulatory Act of 1978.
